WITH source_events AS (
    SELECT 
        session_id,
        stream_id,
        user_pseudo_id,
        property_id,
        MIN(table_suffix) AS table_suffix, -- Find the earliest date of the session
        COUNT(DISTINCT table_suffix) > 1 as is_multiday_session, -- Check if the session covers more than one day
        MAX(is_final) AS is_final,  -- Return true if session started on an is_final day

        -- All the following info will returned with the first record order by time_stamp acs
        ARRAY_AGG(device IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS device, -- device is a Struct in ga4_events
        ARRAY_AGG(geo IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS geo, -- geo is a Struct in ga4_events
        ARRAY_AGG(app_info IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS app_info, -- app_info is a Struct in ga4_events
        ARRAY_AGG(platform IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS platform,

        -- page is a STRUCT defined in ga4_events
        STRUCT(
            ARRAY_AGG(page.location IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS landing_page_location,
            ARRAY_AGG(page.path IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS landing_page_path,
            ARRAY_AGG(page.hostname IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS landing_page_hostname,
            ARRAY_AGG(page.referrer IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS landing_page_referrer,
            ARRAY_AGG(event_params.content_group IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS landing_content_group -- content_group
        ) AS landing_page,

        ARRAY_AGG(session_traffic_source_last_click IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc ASC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS session_traffic_source_last_click,

        -- Sometimes there is an issue when the Struct is not null, but all its sub-Structs (source, medium,
        -- campaign) are all null, which will make the Dataform believe this Struct is not null but make the attribution 
        -- model fails because all the first/last touch points are null, so we need to make sure that the sub-Struct are not all null)
        
        -- fixed_traffic_source is temparely changed to an Array in order to use ARRAY_AGG() to extract
        -- the first or last value for attribution model
        
        ARRAY_AGG(
            IF(
                COALESCE(
                    fixed_traffic_source.campaign_id,
                    fixed_traffic_source.campaign,
                    fixed_traffic_source.source,
                    fixed_traffic_source.medium,
                    fixed_traffic_source.term,
                    fixed_traffic_source.content
                ) IS NULL, NULL, fixed_traffic_source
            )
            IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc asc
            LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET](0) AS first_traffic_source,
        
        ARRAY_AGG(
            IF(
                COALESCE(
                    fixed_traffic_source.campaign_id,
                    fixed_traffic_source.campaign,
                    fixed_traffic_source.source,
                    fixed_traffic_source.medium,
                    fixed_traffic_source.term,
                    fixed_traffic_source.content
                ) IS NULL, NULL, fixed_traffic_source
            )
            IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc desc
            LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET](0) AS last_traffic_source,
        
        ARRAY_AGG(
            IF(
                COALESCE(click_ids.gclid,
click_ids.dclid,
click_ids.srsltid,
click_ids.gbraid,
click_ids.wbraid,
click_ids.gclsrc,
click_ids.msclkid) IS NULL, NULL, click_ids)
                )
            IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc asc
            LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET](0) AS first_click_ids,
        
        ARRAY_AGG(
            IF(
                COALESCE(click_ids.gclid,
click_ids.dclid,
click_ids.srsltid,
click_ids.gbraid,
click_ids.wbraid,
click_ids.gclsrc,
click_ids.msclkid) IS NULL, NULL, click_ids)
                )
            IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc desc
            LIMIT 1)[SAFE_OFFSET](0) AS last_click_ids,

        -- It is always to retrieve the last user_id because if the user needs to purchase anything, he needs to log in
        -- so the user_id can be identified at that time
        ARRAY_AGG(user_id IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS user_id,

        STRUCT(
            ARRAY_AGG(page.location IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS exit_page_location,
            ARRAY_AGG(page.path IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS exit_page_path,
            ARRAY_AGG(page.hostname IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS exit_page_hostname,
            ARRAY_AGG(event_params.content_group IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY time.event_timestamp_utc DESC
    LIMIT 1) [SAFE_OFFSET(0)] AS exit_content_group
        ) AS exit_page,

        -- ga_session_number stands for the times when the same user visits
        -- Theoriotically all the ga_session_number should be the same in the same session_id, but in BigQuery when there is a
        -- group by clause, all the fields should be in an aggregation funtion
        -- also when MP hits happen, MIN() can help fix it as long as there is a valid value in ga_session_number
        MIN(event_params.ga_session_number) AS ga_session_number,

        MIN(event_date) AS session_date,
        MIN(time.event_timestamp_utc) AS session_start_timestamp_utc,
        MAX(time.event_timestamp_utc) AS session_end_timestamp_utc,
        SUM(event_params.engagement_time_msec) AS engagement_time_msec,

        STRUCT(
            -- As long as user has engaged with the page, event_params.session_engaged = "1"
            LOGICAL_OR(event_params.session_engaged = "1") AS is_engaged_session,
            LOGICAL_OR(has_source) AS is_with_source,
            NOT LOGICAL_OR(has_source) AS is_direct_session,
            LOGICAL_OR(url_params.gtm_debug IS NOT NULL) AS is_debug_session, -- If the session is from test data in GTM preview mode
            LOGICAL_OR(url_params._gl IS NOT NULL) AS is_cross_domain -- If the session is from cross-domain tracking config in GA4
        ) AS session_info,

    FROM `bigquery-test-march.pirlo_calligraphy.ga4_events`

    WHERE
        event_date >= date_checkpoint - 1
    AND
        user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND
        session_id IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        session_id,
        stream_id,
        user_pseudo_id,
        property_id
),

source_categories AS (
    SELECT
        source,
        source_category
    FROM `bigquery-test-march.pirlo_calligraphy_i.source_categories`
),

stage_create_session_source_and_time AS (
    SELECT
        source_events.* EXCEPT(
            -- Move the time-related fields into a single Struct in order to make the reports clean and easy to use
            session_start_timestamp_utc,
            session_end_timestamp_utc,
            engagement_time_msec,
            first_traffic_source,
            last_traffic_source,
            first_click_ids,
            last_click_ids
        ),

        STRUCT(
            source_events.session_start_timestamp_utc,
            source_events.session_end_timestamp_utc,
            source_events.engagement_time_msec,
            TIMESTAMP_DIFF(source_events.session_end_timestamp_utc, source_events.session_start_timestamp_utc,
                SECOND) AS session_duration_s
        ) AS time,

        -- SElECT AS STRUCT() is used because .* is used here which is not allowed in STRUCT()
        -- Finally the data structure here is like:
        -- {"session_source":{"first":{"source", "medium", "campaign", "gclid", "default_channel_grouping"}}, {"last":{}}}
        -- therefore the data analyst can use "select session_source.first.default_channel_grouping from ..."
        (
            SELECT AS STRUCT
                (
                    SELECT AS STRUCT
                        first_traffic_source.*,
                        first_click_ids.*,
                        
        case
            when(coalesce(first_traffic_source.source, first_traffic_source.medium, first_traffic_source.campaign, first_traffic_source.term, first_traffic_source.content, first_traffic_source.campaign_id) is not null)
            or (first_traffic_source.source = 'direct' and (first_traffic_source.medium = '(none)' or first_traffic_source.medium = '(not set'))
            then 'Direct'

            when(regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.source, r"^(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter)$")
            or join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SOCIAL')
            and regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Social'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.source, r"^(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter)$")
            or first_traffic_source.medium in ("social", "social-network", "social-media", "sm", "social network", "social media")
            or join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SOCIAL'
            then 'Organic Social'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail|newsletter")
            or regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.source, r"email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail|newsletter")
            then 'Email'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"affiliate|affiliates")
            then 'Affiliates'

            when join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SHOPPING'
            and regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Shopping'

            when join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SHOPPING'
            or first_traffic_source.campaign = 'Shopping Free Listings'
            or first_traffic_source.medium = 'shopping_free'
            then 'Organic Shopping'

            when (join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_VIDEO' and regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$")))
            or first_traffic_source.source = 'dv360_video'
            then 'Paid Video'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(display|cpm|banner)$")
            or first_traffic_source.source = 'dv360_display'
            then 'Display'

            when join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SEARCH'
            and regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Search'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(cpv|cpa|cpp|cpc|content-text)$")
            then 'Other Advertising'

            when first_traffic_source.medium = 'organic' or join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SEARCH'
            then 'Organic Search'

            when join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_VIDEO'
            or regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*video.*)$")
            then 'Organic Video'

            when false
            and first_traffic_source.medium = 'referral'
            and join_first.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_AI'
            then 'Organic AI'

            when first_traffic_source.medium in ("referral", "app", "link")
            then 'Referral'

            when first_traffic_source.medium = 'audio'
            then 'Audio'

            when first_traffic_source.medium = 'sms'
            or first_traffic_source.source = 'sms'
            then 'SMS'

            when regexp_contains(first_traffic_source.medium, r"(mobile|notification|push$)")
            or first_traffic_source.source = 'firebase'
            then 'Mobile Push Notification'

            else '(Other)'
        end 
     AS default_channel_grouping
                    ) AS first,

                (
                    SELECT AS STRUCT
                        last_traffic_source.*,
                        last_click_ids.*,
                        
        case
            when(coalesce(last_traffic_source.source, last_traffic_source.medium, last_traffic_source.campaign, last_traffic_source.term, last_traffic_source.content, last_traffic_source.campaign_id) is not null)
            or (last_traffic_source.source = 'direct' and (last_traffic_source.medium = '(none)' or last_traffic_source.medium = '(not set'))
            then 'Direct'

            when(regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.source, r"^(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter)$")
            or join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SOCIAL')
            and regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Social'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.source, r"^(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter)$")
            or last_traffic_source.medium in ("social", "social-network", "social-media", "sm", "social network", "social media")
            or join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SOCIAL'
            then 'Organic Social'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail|newsletter")
            or regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.source, r"email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail|newsletter")
            then 'Email'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"affiliate|affiliates")
            then 'Affiliates'

            when join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SHOPPING'
            and regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Shopping'

            when join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SHOPPING'
            or last_traffic_source.campaign = 'Shopping Free Listings'
            or last_traffic_source.medium = 'shopping_free'
            then 'Organic Shopping'

            when (join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_VIDEO' and regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$")))
            or last_traffic_source.source = 'dv360_video'
            then 'Paid Video'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(display|cpm|banner)$")
            or last_traffic_source.source = 'dv360_display'
            then 'Display'

            when join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SEARCH'
            and regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$")
            then 'Paid Search'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(cpv|cpa|cpp|cpc|content-text)$")
            then 'Other Advertising'

            when last_traffic_source.medium = 'organic' or join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_SEARCH'
            then 'Organic Search'

            when join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_VIDEO'
            or regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"^(.*video.*)$")
            then 'Organic Video'

            when false
            and last_traffic_source.medium = 'referral'
            and join_last.source_category = 'SOURCE_CATEGORY_AI'
            then 'Organic AI'

            when last_traffic_source.medium in ("referral", "app", "link")
            then 'Referral'

            when last_traffic_source.medium = 'audio'
            then 'Audio'

            when last_traffic_source.medium = 'sms'
            or last_traffic_source.source = 'sms'
            then 'SMS'

            when regexp_contains(last_traffic_source.medium, r"(mobile|notification|push$)")
            or last_traffic_source.source = 'firebase'
            then 'Mobile Push Notification'

            else '(Other)'
        end 
     AS default_channel_grouping
                    ) AS last
        ) AS session_source

    FROM source_events
    LEFT JOIN source_categories AS join_first
        ON source_events.first_traffic_source LIKE join_first.source
    LEFT JOIN source_categories AS join_last
        ON source_events.last_traffic_source LIKE join_last.source
)

SELECT * EXCEPT(is_multiday_session)
FROM stage_create_session_source_and_time
WHERE (
    session_date >= date_checkpoint -- Do not ask BigQuery to refresh the whole data in ga4_events
    OR
    is_multiday_session -- Some session may cover overnight so this one should be included
)

        -- The custom events params
        

        -- Add custom user info from user_properties

        -- ({name: 'user_type', type: 'string'}, {name: 'subscription_tier', type: 'int'})

stage_repack_structs AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            -- These 4 fields are too dirty and need to be cleaned
            ecommerce,
            batch_event_index,
            batch_ordering_id,
            batch_page_id
        ),

        -- In July 2024 the batch_* parameters were moved to a column. So data before that date should
        -- be found from UNNEST(event_params)
        STRUCT(
            batch_event_index,
            COALESCE(batch_ordering_id, event_params.batch_ordering_id) AS batch_ordering_id,
            COALESCE(batch_page_id, event_params.batch_page_id) AS batch_page_id
        ) as batch,

        -- Repack the ecommerce Struct
        -- Fix transaction_id error by GA4, change to Null if "(not set)". BigQuery would treat "(not set)" as
        -- a order number while Null would be ignored
        -- also remove NANs in ecommerce Struct. Any (100 + NAN) would be NAN, so any single NAN is not allowed
        Struct(
            ecommerce.total_item_quantity,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS purchase_revenue_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.purchase_revenue), 0, ecommerce.purchase_revenue) AS purchase_revenue,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.refund_value), 0, ecommerce.refund_value) AS refund_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd) AS refund_value_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.shipping_value), 0, ecommerce.shipping_value) AS shipping_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.shipping_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.shipping_value_in_usd) AS shipping_value_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.tax_value), 0, ecommerce.tax_value) AS tax_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.tax_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.tax_value_in_usd) AS tax_value_in_usd,
            ecommerce.unique_items,
            IF(ecommerce.transaction_id = '(not set)', NULL, ecommerce.transaction_id) AS transaction_id
        ) AS ecommerce

        FROM stage_unnest_params
),

stage_url_parsing_and_event_id AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        -- The following 3 fields are used to extract standard url params and 
        -- custom url params and click_id from page_location and form 3 sepereate Structs

        -- Standard url parameters from config.js
        -- This is silver layer for the url params so that it would be much easier to use as a structured field
        STRUCT (
        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_marketing_tactic=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_marketing_tactic,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_source_platform=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_source_platform,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_term=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_term,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_content=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_content,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_source=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_source,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_medium=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_medium,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_campaign=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_campaign,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_id=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_id,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(lower(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]utm_creative_format=([^&#]+)")), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS utm_creative_format,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]gtm_debug=([^&#]+)"), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS gtm_debug,

        (SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(
            ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(
                IF(STARTS_WITH(y, '%'), FROM_HEX(SUBSTR(y, 2)), CAST(y AS BYTES)) ORDER BY i), b''))
        FROM UNNEST(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]_gl=([^&#]+)"), r"%[0-9a-fA-F]{2}|[^%]+")) AS y WITH OFFSET AS i
    ) AS _gl) AS url_params,

        -- Custom url parameters from config.js
        

        -- click_id from event_params based on config.js
        STRUCT (regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]gclid=([^&#]+)") AS gclid,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]dclid=([^&#]+)") AS dclid,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]srsltid=([^&#]+)") AS srsltid,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]gbraid=([^&#]+)") AS gbraid,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]wbraid=([^&#]+)") AS wbraid,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]gclsrc=([^&#]+)") AS gclsrc,
regexp_extract(event_params.page_location, r"^[^#]+[?&]msclkid=([^&#]+)") AS msclkid) AS click_ids,

        -- Create events_id. GA4 raw data does not contain an Event ID (a unique event identifier)
        FARM_FINGERPRINT(
            event_name
            || time.event_timestamp
            || COALESCE(user_pseudo_id, 'no')
            || COALESCE(event_params.ga_session_id, 0)
            || COALESCE(batch.batch_page_id, 0)
            || COALESCE(batch.batch_ordering_id, 0)
            || COALESCE(batch.batch_event_index, 0)
            || COALESCE(event_params.engagement_time_msec, 0)
        ) AS event_id

    FROM stage_repack_structs
),

stage_discard_synthetic_bundle_events AS (
    -- Discard the system-triggered events which were created by GA4 “Audience Triggers”
    SELECT
        *
    FROM stage_url_parsing_and_event_id
    WHERE (event_params.synthetic_bundle IS NULL or event_params.synthetic_bundle != 1)
),

stage_traffic_source_coalesce_and_click_ids AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            click_ids
        ),

        -- The following code follows the priority order: official fields > event params > URL params
        -- to consolidate them into a single source of truth
        -- Here we directly create a Struct without using helpers.generateStructSQL()
        STRUCT(
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_id, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, url_params.utm_id))) AS campaign_id,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_name, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.campaign, url_params.utm_campaign)))) AS campaign,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_source, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.source, url_params.utm_source)))) AS source,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_medium, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.medium, url_params.utm_medium)))) AS medium,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_term, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.term, url_params.utm_term)))) AS term,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_content, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.content, url_params.utm_content)))) AS content,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_source_platform, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.source_platform, url_params.utm_source_platform)))) AS source_platform,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_creative_format, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.creative_format, url_params.utm_creative_format)))) AS creative_format,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_marketing_tactic, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.marketing_tactic, url_params.utm_marketing_tactic)))) AS marketing_tactic
        ) AS fixed_traffic_source,

        STRUCT(
            COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.gclid, event_params.gclid, 
        click_ids.gclid) AS gclid, COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.dclid, event_params.dclid, 
        click_ids.dclid) AS dclid, COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.srsltid, event_params.srsltid, 
        click_ids.srsltid) AS srsltid, click_ids.gbraid AS gbraid, click_ids.wbraid AS wbraid, click_ids.gclsrc AS gclsrc, click_ids.msclkid AS msclkid
        ) AS click_ids

    FROM stage_discard_synthetic_bundle_events
    WHERE event_date >= date_checkpoint
),

-- Fix several attribution error:
-- ad traffic containing gclid is often broken and misclassified by GA4 as organic or referral traffic;
-- traffic coming from the Google app or social media apps may appear as android-app://com... package names;
-- payment redirects such as PayPal, if not excluded, can interrupt the original traffic session.
stage_create_fixed_traffic_source AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            fixed_traffic_source
        ),

        -- Campaign, campaign source & campaign medium should be rewrite if necessary
        -- The correction of campaign, source & medium are processed at the same time because they are in the same CTE
        -- so that each Struct receive the same dataset from the previous CTE and process the correction without
        -- interferring each other

        STRUCT(
            fixed_traffic_source.campaign_id,

            -- Firstly campaign

            CASE
                WHEN(
                    -- Suspected campaign found because these traffic may be broken by GA4
                    (COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                    OR fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL
                )
                THEN
                    -- when the traffic are from ads, we use "(not set)" to name the campaign because we don't amd
                    -- cound't find the orginal campaign name
                    CASE when click_ids.gclid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'Shopping Free Listings'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then '(not set)'
                    -- when the traffic are organic
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.campaign
                END
                -- when the traffic params are perfectly retained
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.campaign
            END AS campaign,

            -- Then campaign source
            CASE
                -- Correct traffic from the Google official mobile apps which might be ignored by GA4
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app://com.google%'
                THEN 'google'

                -- Correct traffic from the third party Android mobile apps which might be ignored by GA4
                -- Use net.host() to extract the domain name if the referrer is non-google Android
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app%'
                THEN net.host(event_params.page_referrer)

                -- When the traffic source has referral but was broken by GA4 or
                -- when the traffic source is payment gateway and ignore_referrer = true, in this case should be ignored
                -- Here event_params.ignore_referrer != true can only be taken into effect when certain website like Paypal
                -- has been added into the list in GA4
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.ignore_referrer != 'true' AND
                event_params.page_referrer IS NOT NULL
                THEN net.host(event_params.page_referrer)

                -- This part tries to find the source by the clickId where the traffic are from ads
                WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                OR (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL)
                -- If there exists clickId, that should be from ads
                THEN
                    CASE
                        when click_ids.gclid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then 'bing'
                    -- otherwise that is from organic search
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.source
                END
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.source
            END AS source,

            -- Lastly campaign medium
            CASE
                WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                OR (fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL)
                THEN
                    CASE
                        when click_ids.gclid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'organic'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then 'cpc'
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.medium
                END

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app://com.google%'
                    THEN 'organic'
                
                -- Here can be improved in the next update since something like 'com.instagram.android' in the medium
                -- should be translated into instagram in the source
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(event_params.page_referrer, r'^android-app.*(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter).*')
                    THEN 'social'

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer like '%android-app%'
                    THEN 'android-app'

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.ignore_referrer != 'true' AND
                event_params.page_referrer IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'referral'
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.medium
            END AS medium,
        
            fixed_traffic_source.term,
            fixed_traffic_source.content,
            fixed_traffic_source.source_platform,
            fixed_traffic_source.creative_format,
            fixed_traffic_source.marketing_tactic
        ) AS fixed_traffic_source
    FROM stage_traffic_source_coalesce_and_click_ids
),

stage_add_meta_info AS (
    SELECT  
        * EXCEPT(time),
        (
        SELECT AS STRUCT
            time.*,
            DATETIME(time.event_timestamp_utc, 'Australia/Adelaide') AS timestamp_local,
            DATE(DATETIME(time.event_timestamp_utc, 'Australia/Adelaide')) AS date_local
        ) AS time,

        -- Identify the Measurement Protocol events which were sent to GA4 by web server, CRM and etc for offline conversion update,
        -- third-party system integration and etc
        -- On 2025-06-11, GA4 introduced batch_page_id which will set the event a batch_page_id when visitors browsing the page with
        -- true browsers. For events before 2025-06-11, 
        CASE
            WHEN event_date >= '2025-06-11' AND platform = 'WEB' AND batch.batch_page_id IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN event_date < '2025-06-11' AND device.language IS NULL AND device.operating_system IS NULL AND device.category = 'desktop' THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_measurement_protocol_hit,

        FARM_FINGERPRINT(user_pseudo_id || event_params.ga_session_id) AS session_id,

        -- All page info in a single Struct
        STRUCT(
            LOWER(net.host(event_params.page_location)) AS hostname,
            event_params.page_location AS location,
            -- Extract the clean path from the page url
            REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_params.page_location, r'^(?:(?:[^:\/?#]+):)?(?:\/\/(?:[^\/?#]*))?([^?#]*)(?:\?(?:[^#]*))?(?:#(?:.*))?') AS path,
            event_params.page_referrer AS referrer,
            event_params.page_title AS title
        ) AS page,

        -- This field might be critically important when identifying which traffic are from organic or marketing in the reports
        CASE
            -- Identity the direct traffic source
            WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL) THEN false
            -- Identity the direct traffic source in GA4
            WHEN (LOWER(fixed_traffic_source.source) IN ('direct', '(direct)') 
            AND LOWER(fixed_traffic_source.medium) IN ('none', '(none)', '(not set)')) THEN false
            -- The rest such as cpc, social, seo, has source
            ELSE true
        END AS has_source

    FROM stage_create_fixed_traffic_source
),

stage_dedupe_by_event_id AS (
    SELECT
    -- Remove the following fields in the Struct in order to reduce the enquery cost in BigQuery
    -- since these fields already exist in the page Struct in CTE stage_add_meta_info
    -- batch_page_id, batch_ordering_id were available before July 2024 and now put into batch Struct in 
    -- CTE stage_repack_structs
        * REPLACE((SELECT AS STRUCT event_params.* EXCEPT(
            batch_ordering_id,
            batch_page_id,
            page_location,
            page_referrer,
            page_title
            )) AS event_params
        )
    FROM stage_add_meta_info
    -- Elegantly remove the duplicated events which might caused by GA4 sening data for multiple times
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id) = 1
),

final_add_row_numbers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        -- Calculate hit numbers to build the clickstream for each visitor in one session
        STRUCT(
            IF(user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND event_params.ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id, event_params.ga_session_id ORDER BY time.event_timestamp ASC)
            , NULL)
            AS hit_number,

        -- Calculate page number in one session
            IF(user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND event_params.ga_session_id IS NOT NULL AND batch.batch_page_id IS NOT NULL
            , DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id, event_params.ga_session_id ORDER BY batch.batch_page_id ASC)
            , NULL)
            AS page_number
        ) AS session_info

    FROM stage_dedupe_by_event_id
)

-- Finanlly it arrives the ending
SELECT
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS _run_timestamp, -- Indicate when the row was last run
    *
FROM final_add_row_numbers

stage_repack_structs AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            -- These 4 fields are too dirty and need to be cleaned
            ecommerce,
            batch_event_index,
            batch_ordering_id,
            batch_page_id
        ),

        -- In July 2024 the batch_* parameters were moved to a column. So data before that date should
        -- be found from UNNEST(event_params)
        STRUCT(
            batch_event_index,
            COALESCE(batch_ordering_id, event_params.batch_ordering_id) AS batch_ordering_id,
            COALESCE(batch_page_id, event_params.batch_page_id) AS batch_page_id
        ) as batch,

        -- Repack the ecommerce Struct
        -- Fix transaction_id error by GA4, change to Null if "(not set)". BigQuery would treat "(not set)" as
        -- a order number while Null would be ignored
        -- also remove NANs in ecommerce Struct. Any (100 + NAN) would be NAN, so any single NAN is not allowed
        Struct(
            ecommerce.total_item_quantity,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS purchase_revenue_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.purchase_revenue), 0, ecommerce.purchase_revenue) AS purchase_revenue,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.refund_value), 0, ecommerce.refund_value) AS refund_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.refund_value_in_usd) AS refund_value_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.shipping_value), 0, ecommerce.shipping_value) AS shipping_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.shipping_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.shipping_value_in_usd) AS shipping_value_in_usd,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.tax_value), 0, ecommerce.tax_value) AS tax_value,
            IF(IS_NAN(ecommerce.tax_value_in_usd), 0, ecommerce.tax_value_in_usd) AS tax_value_in_usd,
            ecommerce.unique_items,
            IF(ecommerce.transaction_id = '(not set)', NULL, ecommerce.transaction_id) AS transaction_id
        ) AS ecommerce

        FROM stage_unnest_params
),

            || COALESCE(event_params.ga_session_id, 0)

stage_discard_synthetic_bundle_events AS (

stage_traffic_source_coalesce_and_click_ids AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            click_ids
        ),

        -- The following code follows the priority order: official fields > event params > URL params
        -- to consolidate them into a single source of truth
        -- Here we directly create a Struct without using helpers.generateStructSQL()
        STRUCT(
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_id, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, url_params.utm_id))) AS campaign_id,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_campaign_name, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.campaign, url_params.utm_campaign)))) AS campaign,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_source, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.source, url_params.utm_source)))) AS source,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_medium, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.medium, url_params.utm_medium)))) AS medium,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_term, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.term, url_params.utm_term)))) AS term,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_content, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.content, url_params.utm_content)))) AS content,
            LOWER(COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.manual_source_platform, IF(batch.batch_ordering_id > 1, NULL, COALESCE(event_params.source_platform, url_params.utm_source_platform)))) AS source_platform,

        ) AS fixed_traffic_source,

            COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.gclid, event_params.gclid, 
        click_ids.gclid) AS gclid, COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.dclid, event_params.dclid, 
        click_ids.dclid) AS dclid, COALESCE(collected_traffic_source.srsltid, event_params.srsltid, 
        click_ids.srsltid) AS srsltid, click_ids.gbraid AS gbraid, click_ids.wbraid AS wbraid, click_ids.gclsrc AS gclsrc, click_ids.msclkid AS msclkid

),

-- Fix several attribution error:
-- ad traffic containing gclid is often broken and misclassified by GA4 as organic or referral traffic;
-- traffic coming from the Google app or social media apps may appear as android-app://com... package names;
-- payment redirects such as PayPal, if not excluded, can interrupt the original traffic session.
stage_create_fixed_traffic_source AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(
            fixed_traffic_source
        ),

        -- Campaign, campaign source & campaign medium should be rewrite if necessary
        -- The correction of campaign, source & medium are processed at the same time because they are in the same CTE
        -- so that each Struct receive the same dataset from the previous CTE and process the correction without
        -- interferring each other

        STRUCT(
            fixed_traffic_source.campaign_id,

            -- Firstly campaign

            CASE
                WHEN(
                    -- Suspected campaign found because these traffic may be broken by GA4
                    (COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                    OR fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL
                )
                THEN
                    -- when the traffic are from ads, we use "(not set)" to name the campaign because we don't amd
                    -- cound't find the orginal campaign name
                    CASE when click_ids.gclid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'Shopping Free Listings'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then '(not set)'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then '(not set)'
                    -- when the traffic are organic
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.campaign
                END
                -- when the traffic params are perfectly retained
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.campaign
            END AS campaign,

            -- Then campaign source
            CASE
                -- Correct traffic from the Google official mobile apps which might be ignored by GA4
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app://com.google%'
                THEN 'google'

                -- Correct traffic from the third party Android mobile apps which might be ignored by GA4
                -- Use net.host() to extract the domain name if the referrer is non-google Android
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app%'
                THEN net.host(event_params.page_referrer)

                -- When the traffic source has referral but was broken by GA4 or
                -- when the traffic source is payment gateway and ignore_referrer = true, in this case should be ignored
                -- Here event_params.ignore_referrer != true can only be taken into effect when certain website like Paypal
                -- has been added into the list in GA4
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND event_params.ignore_referrer != 'true' AND
                event_params.page_referrer IS NOT NULL
                THEN net.host(event_params.page_referrer)

                -- This part tries to find the source by the clickId where the traffic are from ads
                WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                OR (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL)
                -- If there exists clickId, that should be from ads
                THEN
                    CASE
                        when click_ids.gclid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then 'google'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then 'bing'
                    -- otherwise that is from organic search
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.source
                END
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.source
            END AS source,

            -- Lastly campaign medium
            CASE
                WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(fixed_traffic_source.campaign, '') IN ('(organic)', '(referral)', ''))
                OR (fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.campaign IS NULL)
                THEN
                    CASE
                        when click_ids.gclid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.dclid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.srsltid is not null then 'organic'
when click_ids.gbraid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.wbraid is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.gclsrc is not null then 'cpc'
when click_ids.msclkid is not null then 'cpc'
                    ELSE fixed_traffic_source.medium
                END

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer LIKE '%android-app://com.google%'
                    THEN 'organic'
                
                -- Here can be improved in the next update since something like 'com.instagram.android' in the medium
                -- should be translated into instagram in the source
                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(event_params.page_referrer, r'^android-app.*(pinterest|facebook|instagram|reddit|tiktok|linkedin|snapchat|messenger|twitter).*')
                    THEN 'social'

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.page_referrer like '%android-app%'
                    THEN 'android-app'

                WHEN fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL AND event_params.ignore_referrer != 'true' AND
                event_params.page_referrer IS NOT NULL
                    THEN 'referral'
                ELSE fixed_traffic_source.medium
            END AS medium,
        
            fixed_traffic_source.term,
            fixed_traffic_source.content,
            fixed_traffic_source.source_platform,
            fixed_traffic_source.creative_format,
            fixed_traffic_source.marketing_tactic
        ) AS fixed_traffic_source
    FROM stage_traffic_source_coalesce_and_click_ids
),

stage_add_meta_info AS (
    SELECT  
        * EXCEPT(time),
        (
        SELECT AS STRUCT
            time.*,
            DATETIME(time.event_timestamp_utc, 'Australia/Adelaide') AS timestamp_local,
            DATE(DATETIME(time.event_timestamp_utc, 'Australia/Adelaide')) AS date_local
        ) AS time,

        -- Identify the Measurement Protocol events which were sent to GA4 by web server, CRM and etc for offline conversion update,
        -- third-party system integration and etc
        -- On 2025-06-11, GA4 introduced batch_page_id which will set the event a batch_page_id when visitors browsing the page with
        -- true browsers. For events before 2025-06-11, 
        CASE
            WHEN event_date >= '2025-06-11' AND platform = 'WEB' AND batch.batch_page_id IS NULL THEN true
            WHEN event_date < '2025-06-11' AND device.language IS NULL AND device.operating_system IS NULL AND device.category = 'desktop' THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS is_measurement_protocol_hit,

        FARM_FINGERPRINT(user_pseudo_id || event_params.ga_session_id) AS session_id,

        -- All page info in a single Struct
        STRUCT(
            LOWER(net.host(event_params.page_location)) AS hostname,
            event_params.page_location AS location,
            -- Extract the clean path from the page url
            REGEXP_EXTRACT(event_params.page_location, r'^(?:(?:[^:\/?#]+):)?(?:\/\/(?:[^\/?#]*))?([^?#]*)(?:\?(?:[^#]*))?(?:#(?:.*))?') AS path,
            event_params.page_referrer AS referrer,
            event_params.page_title AS title
        ) AS page,

        -- This field might be critically important when identifying which traffic are from organic or marketing in the reports
        CASE
            -- Identity the direct traffic source
            WHEN (fixed_traffic_source.source IS NULL AND fixed_traffic_source.medium IS NULL) THEN false
            -- Identity the direct traffic source in GA4
            WHEN (LOWER(fixed_traffic_source.source) IN ('direct', '(direct)') 
            AND LOWER(fixed_traffic_source.medium) IN ('none', '(none)', '(not set)')) THEN false
            -- The rest such as cpc, social, seo, has source
            ELSE true
        END AS has_source

    FROM stage_create_fixed_traffic_source
),

stage_dedupe_by_event_id AS (
    SELECT
    -- Remove the following fields in the Struct in order to reduce the enquery cost in BigQuery
    -- since these fields already exist in the page Struct in CTE stage_add_meta_info
    -- batch_page_id, batch_ordering_id were available before July 2024 and now put into batch Struct in 
    -- CTE stage_repack_structs
        * REPLACE((SELECT AS STRUCT event_params.* EXCEPT(
            batch_ordering_id,
            batch_page_id,
            page_location,
            page_referrer,
            page_title
            )) AS event_params
        )
    FROM stage_add_meta_info
    -- Elegantly remove the duplicated events which might caused by GA4 sening data for multiple times
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_id) = 1
),

final_add_row_numbers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        -- Calculate hit numbers to build the clickstream for each visitor in one session
        STRUCT(
            IF(user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND event_params.ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
            , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id, event_params.ga_session_id ORDER BY time.event_timestamp ASC)
            , NULL)
            AS hit_number,

        -- Calculate page number in one session
            IF(user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND event_params.ga_session_id IS NOT NULL AND batch.batch_page_id IS NOT NULL
            , DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id, event_params.ga_session_id ORDER BY batch.batch_page_id ASC)
            , NULL)
            AS page_number
        ) AS session_info

    FROM stage_dedupe_by_event_id
)

-- Finanlly it arrives the ending
SELECT
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS _run_timestamp, -- Indicate when the row was last run
    *
FROM final_add_row_numbers

-- so this duplicated transaction records caused should be removed
WITH source_transactions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        IF(
            event_name = 'purchase',
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
                PARTITION BY
                    -- If anything wrong with the transanction_id from the ecommcerce system and transaction_id becomes
                    -- NULL, we still can find the unique purchase event by using event_id we created
                    COALESCE(transaction_id, CAST(event_id AS STRING))
                ORDER BY time.event_timestamp
            ) ,1) AS duplicate_count

    FROM `bigquery-test-march.pirlo_calligraphy_i.int_ga4_transactions`

stage_purchases AS (
    SELECT
        * EXCEPT(event_name, item_totals)
        STRUCT(
            item_totals.quantity,
            item_totals.item_revenue,
            item_totals.item_revenue_in_usd,
            item_totals.coupons,
            item_totals.unique_coupons
        ) AS item_totals,

        duplicate_count > 1 AS is_duplicate,

        -- This STRUCT uses RFM model to analyse the every user's behaviors
        STRUCT(
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER user) AS transactions,
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, SUM(ecommerce.purchase_revenue) OVER user) AS purchase_revenue,
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, SUM(ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd) OVER user) AS purchase_revenue_in_usd,
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, SUM(ecommerce.total_item_quantity) OVER user) AS total_item_quantity,

            -- The last time when buyers made the purchase
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
                time.event_timestamp_utc,
                LAG(time.event_timestamp_utc) OVER user,
                SECOND)
            ) AS seconds_since_previous_purchase,

            -- The next time when buyers made the purchase
            IF(uid IS NULL, NULL, TIMESTAMP_DIFF(
                LEAD(time.event_timestamp_utc) OVER user,
                time.event_timestamp_utc,
                SECOND)
            ) AS seconds_to_next_purchase
        ) AS running_totals

    FROM source_transactions
    WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    WINDOW user AS (PARTITION BY uid ORDER BY time.event_timestamp)
),

stage_refunds AS (
    SELECT
        transaction_id,
        -- Calculate the number of refunds within a transaction
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_refunds,

        STRUCT(
            MIN(time.event_timestamp_utc) AS min_refund_timestamp, -- The earliest refund
            MAX(time.event_timestamp_utc) AS max_refund_timestamp, -- The latest refund

            STRUCT(
                SUM(item_totals.quantity) AS quantity,
                SUM(item_totals.item_refund_in_usd) AS item_refund_in_usd,
                SUM(item_totals.item_refund) AS item_refund
            ) AS refund_item_totals,

            -- Every details of refund retained in the array for micro anaysis
            ARRAY_AGG(
                STRUCT(
                    event_id,
                    session_id,
                    user_pseudo_id,
                    user_id,
                    uid,
                    stream_id,
                    platform,
                    time,
                    currency,
                    coupon,
                    items AS items,
                    STRUCT(
                        item_totals.quantity,
                        item_totals.item_refund_in_usd,
                        item_totals.item_refund,
                        item_totals.coupons,
                        item_totals.unique_coupons
                    ) AS item_totals
                )
            ) AS refunds

        ) AS refund_info

    FROM source_transactions
    WHERE event_name = 'refunds'
    GROUP BY ALL -- Aggregate all the non-aggragation fields
),

final_add_totals AS (
    SELECT
        stage_purchases.*,

        -- Using COALESCE() to avoid non-refund transaction. In SQL 100 - NULL = NULL
        -- Using ABS() to make sure all the refunds are positive number
        STRUCT(
            item_totals.quantity - COALESCE(ABS(refund_info.refund_item_totals.quantity), 0) AS quantity,
            item_totals.item_refund_in_usd - COALESCE(ABS(refund_info.refund_item_totals.item_refund_in_usd), 0) AS item_revenue_in_usd,
            item_totals.item_revenue - COALESCE(ABS(refund_info.refund_item_totals.item_refund), 0) AS item_revenue
        ) AS net_item_totals,

        COALESCE(stage_refunds.number_of_refunds, 0) AS number_of_refunds,
        stage_refunds.* EXCEPT(transaction_id, number_of_refunds)

    FROM stage_purchases
    -- Not every trasaction will have a refund so left join must be used here
    LEFT JOIN stage_refunds USING (transaction_id)
),

SELECT * FROM final_add_totals
